name: Disable Nagle Algorithm
description: Disables the Nagle algorithm on TCP connections to reduce latency for small packets.

description_i18n.en: Disables the Nagle algorithm on TCP connections to reduce latency for small packets.
description_i18n.de: Deaktiviert den Nagle-Algorithmus auf TCP-Verbindungen, um die Latenz für kleine Pakete zu reduzieren.
description_i18n.fr: Désactive l'algorithme de Nagle sur les connexions TCP pour réduire la latence des petits paquets.

warnings.title: Potential Network Instability
warnings.message: Disabling Nagle may cause increased CPU usage on high-latency connections and can lead to packet reordering issues in some network environments

warnings.title: Registry change
warnings.message: Persistent Windows settings may change until the tweak is restored

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: Writes TCPNoDelay to 1 and TcpAckFrequency to 1 under HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\Tcpip\Parameters\Interfaces for each active physical network adapter, then reports the tweak as enabled when those values are present.
